title: Tech & architecture slides for the Veikkaus deck
subtitle: Two slides for deck-writer: slide 1 is the 'Technical methodology and deliverables' section, slide 2 merges into 'Implementation plan and timeline'
footer: Recordly | Veikkaus | Data and AI architecture assessment

slides.title: We read evidence at every layer of your stack, labelled the way your brief labels it
bullets: **Licence baseline first:** entitlement vs. actual use per multi-year commitment, from the admin and usage logs you have. A new component is proposed only where existing capacity fails a tested need.

**Proof, not promises:** every finding is a card with log evidence and a compliance note, or is marked "confidence low, evidence requested". Options are scored on five weighted criteria from your brief; compliance is also a pass/fail gate.
**Model deployment is measured, not rebuilt:** lead time and manual hand-offs per step on your in-house AI platform. Vendor-neutral: products are confirmed in week 1.
**Sample finding card:** "Nightly player-reporting job, 14 of 90 runs failed, 3 manual restarts. Source: task log. Impact: late reports. Compliance: audit trail OK, lineage gap. Confidence: medium."

**Checks added:** D2: is localisation of player-facing report and model outputs a pipeline step (finding, not fix). D3: rollback tested on one past deployment where history exists. D4: option C is a paper sketch only, no tool bake-off; throughput scored on peak load and batch lag from task logs, run cost per option is a scoring input.

columns.title: Cloud data platform
boxes: D2 debt: failures, manual steps, duplicate logic, lineage gaps
D1 / D4: volumes, job durations, peak load

columns.title: In-house AI platform
boxes: D3: lead time and hand-offs per step; rollback and monitoring checked

diagram.band: Scope map in your brief's own labels, not your confirmed architecture. Every finding: access control, audit trail, lineage, player-data handling. Arrows indicative: data / models / reports.

slides.title: Three gates keep the assessment honest: access, evidence quality, compliance
table: Named read-only accounts issued by Veikkaus, access list and NDA signed; metadata and counts only. If approval is late, your admins export the logs and the plan moves by the delay
Target: ≥80% of commitments have usage data and ≥10 debt items are log-evidenced, confirmed with you after week 1. Scoring anchors agreed. Otherwise re-scope before phase 3
An option that fails on access control, audit trail, lineage or player-data handling is not recommended, whatever its score
Changes are proposed, never applied; every cut-over step has an owner and your approval
slides.note: Technical unknowns: the products and licence terms behind "cloud data platform" and "in-house AI platform" (week-1 checklist); whether usage logs can be exported (gaps shown on the D1 cards); deployment history shorter than 6 months (lead time shown as a range); current volumes (throughput scored against measured load, no real-time promise).
